Definition: probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine:--Dalmanutha.
BiblicalUsage: Dalmanutha is named once, as the place where Jesus landed after feeding the four thousand. The Pharisees came out there to test Him, seeking a sign from heaven, and He sighed deeply and refused them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the place is a warning: even after a miracle, men can demand one more sign and miss the One standing in front of them.
